thread:
alex: Heads-up — proposal for a staged rollout policy for the new quant variants (AWQ/GPTQ/INT8/FP8). I ran the bakeoff on the eval harness and have suggested thresholds + phased traffic plan. Sharing details below so we can align on hosted/dedicated/private behaviors.

maria: SGTM. Can you attach the top-line numbers first? quick glance is fine.

alex: Sure. Top-line (vs fp16 baseline): MMLU mean accuracy delta: AWQ -0.6%, GPTQ -0.9%, INT8 -1.5%, FP8 -0.4%. Latency p95 (same infra): AWQ 12ms lower, GPTQ 8ms lower, INT8 20ms lower, FP8 9ms lower. Hallucination-rate (LM-TrueCheck): AWQ +0.08pp, GPTQ +0.12pp, INT8 +0.3pp, FP8 +0.05pp.

cheng: Those deltas are small for AWQ/FP8. Do we have variation across prompt families? e.g., code-gen vs closed QA?

alex: Yes — breakdown: reasoning prompts see larger drop for GPTQ/INT8 (~1.2–2.0%), QA & summarization <0.5% for AWQ/FP8. Code-gen shows token-level correctness drop for INT8 only. I can paste per-suite numbers if folks want.

noah: Important: dedicated pools will have stricter rollback rules because customers expect predictable quality. I propose more conservative stages for dedicated/private.

alex: Agreed. Draft rollout plan (phases):
```
- phase 0: internal smoke, 0% external traffic, run eval harness + 48h soak on staging
- phase 1: 1% traffic (random sample), 6h checks, quality gates: MMLU delta <= -0.8%, hallucination delta <= +0.2pp, error-rate < 0.1%, latency p95 <= +20% of baseline
- phase 2: 5% traffic, 24h checks, same gates tightened to MMLU delta <= -0.5%
- phase 3: 20% traffic, 72h checks, auto-rollforward if all checks green; auto-rollback if any gate violates
- phase 4: 100% rollout
```

alex: Rollout profiles: hosted = follow phases above. Dedicated = start at phase1 but require manual approval to go phase2 and above; also require tenant-level perf smoke tests. Private/on-prem = only after successful dedicated rollout and comms; by default manual.

maria: How does fallback work? If AWQ starts failing for some tenants, do we route to fp16 or to another quant variant?

noah: My suggestion: two-tier fallback: first try higher-precision quant (FP8 -> AWQ -> fp16) based on compatibility, then full fp16 as final fallback. Also enforce circuit-breaker on error spike or quality regression signal.

alex: Implemented prototype policy in rollout-bot config:
```
policies:
  - name: quant-phased-default
    fallbacks: ["fp8", "awq", "fp16"]
    triggers:
      - name: error_rate
        threshold: 0.001
      - name: quality_drop_mmlu
        threshold: -0.8
      - name: latency_p95_pct
        threshold: 1.2
    stages: [0,1,2,3,4]
    rollback_action: auto
    manual_approval_for: ["dedicated","private"]
```

rollout-bot: [automation] Phase 1 job created: rollout-id=rl-20260320-1. Running eval hooks every 5m, alerts -> #incidents if gate fails.

eva: Eval snapshots from last run (short):
```
Suite    | baseline | awq_delta | gptq_delta | int8_delta | fp8_delta
MMLU     | 73.4     | -0.6      | -0.9       | -1.5       | -0.4
SQuAD    | 88.2     | -0.3      | -0.5       | -1.1       | -0.2
Code-Tok | 91.0     | -0.2      | -1.0       | -2.5       | -0.3
Halluc%  | 0.80     | +0.08     | +0.12      | +0.30      | +0.05
```

maria: Nice. For hosted customers I'd be comfortable with AWQ and FP8 in phase3 if the harness stays green. GPTQ/INT8 need extra checks for reasoning/code families.

cheng: Operational note: AWQ has different memory patterns; need to ensure cache/warmup config on dedicated instances. Also batching thresholds differ. I'll add an infra checklist to the ticket.

alex: Good call. I'll add per-variant runtime config suggestions to the rollout job. Example (for dedicated pools):
```
awq:
  kv_cache_prefetch: true
  min_batch_ms: 6
  max_batch_tokens: 4096
int8:
  min_batch_ms: 12
  max_batch_tokens: 2048
fp8:
  min_batch_ms: 6
  max_batch_tokens: 4096
```

noah: One more ask: tie user-facing A/B with eval harness. If we see client-level regression (customer-reported quality), that should trigger immediate tenant rollback and a high-priority incident.

maria: Agreed. Also, for private deployments, include a preflight that runs a deterministic eval subset (same RNG seeds) to ensure bit-exact reproducibility where possible.

alex: I'll update the rollout job and open PR for rollout-bot policy + infra checklist. Plan to start phase0 tonight on staging. If nobody objects I'll kick off.

maria: go for it. ping me if phase1 wants manual approval for any dedicated tenant. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deploy accepted — job rl-20260320-1 queued on staging.
